WARD 7B VISITING HOURS
Afternoons 14:00 to 16:00
Evenings 18:30 to 20:00
A maximum of 2 visitors per bed at any time.
Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult.
Please use the hand gel at the entrance to the ward.
Ward office: ext. 4471

NOTICE TO PASSENGERS
Liquids in hand luggage must be in containers of 100ml or less.
All containers must fit in one clear resealable bag, approx. 20cm x 20cm.
Laptops and tablets larger than a phone must be removed from your bag.
Thank you for your patience. Average wait today: 12 min.

LIFT OUT OF SERVICE
Lift 2 (east core) will be closed for maintenance from Mon 19 Oct to Fri 23 Oct.
Please use Lift 1 or Lift 3. The stairs are on your left.
Anyone needing assistance can call Facilities on ext. 2200.
We apologise for any inconvenience.

Platform 4 Engineering Works
On Sunday 25 October no trains will call at this platform between 06:00 and 13:30.
Services to Ashworth and Pellbridge will depart from Platform 2 instead.
Replacement buses run every 20 minutes from the station forecourt, Bay C.
Allow up to 45 min extra for your journey.

PLEASE NOTE
This is a fragrance-free area.
Patients on this unit may be sensitive to perfume, aftershave and scented sprays.
Flowers are not permitted on the Respiratory Unit (Ward 12).
Room temperature is kept at 21°C to 23°C.
Questions? Ask the nurse in charge or call 01632 960274.

KITCHEN RULES, 4th FLOOR
The fridge is cleared every Friday at 4:00 pm. Anything without a name and date goes.
Load the dishwasher, don't stack it in the sink.
The boiling water tap reaches 98°C. Keep fingers clear.
Milk rota: Team A weeks 1 & 3, Team B weeks 2 & 4.

Lost Property
Items found on buses or in the station are kept at the Travel Centre for 28 days.
Opening hours Mon to Sat 08:00 to 18:00, Sun 10:00 to 16:00.
A handling fee of $3.00 applies to items over $50 in value.
Phone 555-0162 or email lostproperty@riverlinetransit.example

FIRE EVACUATION POINT B
In the event of a fire alarm, leave the building by the nearest exit.
Do not use the lifts.
Assemble here and wait for the Fire Marshal to take a roll call.
Do not re-enter until told it is safe.
Fire Marshal for Floors 1 to 3: K. Abiodun, ext. 3109

GATE CHANGE
Flight PX 772 to Valmorra now departs from Gate 31, not Gate 18.
Boarding begins at 19:05 and the gate closes at 19:35, 15 minutes before departure.
Walking time from here is approx. 12 minutes.
We regret any inconvenience.

SECURE AREA
Access to Floors 9 and 10 is by pass only.
Visitors must sign in at reception on the ground floor and wear a badge at all times.
Tailgating through the turnstiles is a disciplinary matter.
Report lost passes immediately to Security on 07700 900316, 24 hours a day.

Pharmacy Opening Times
Monday to Friday 8.30am to 6.00pm
Saturday 9.00am to 1.00pm
Sunday and bank holidays closed
Out of hours prescriptions: please go to the Emergency Department reception.
Average waiting time for a prescription is 25 to 40 minutes.

Escalator Closure
The escalators at the Calder Street entrance are being replaced.
Work starts 2 November 2026 and is expected to finish by 15 January 2027.
Step-free access is available via the lift at the Wyndham Road entrance, 150m north.
We're sorry for the disruption.

Car Park Notice
Spaces 1 to 24 are reserved for disabled badge holders and visitors.
Staff parking permits must be displayed on the dashboard.
Vehicles parked without a permit after 9:30 am may be clamped. Release fee £85.
Enquiries: Estates Office, Room G.14, ext. 5012

Clinic Running Late
Dr Moreno's clinic is running approx. 40 minutes behind.
Patients booked from 10:30 onwards will be seen in order of appointment.
If you cannot wait, please speak to reception at Desk 3 to rebook.
Hot drinks are available in the café on Level 1 until 4pm.

Ward 9 Banana Bread (makes 1 loaf, 10 slices)
3 ripe bananas, mashed
75g butter, melted
150g caster sugar
1 egg, beaten
1 tsp bicarbonate of soda
190g plain flour
Mix everything in one bowl, pour into a lined 900g loaf tin and bake at 175°C (gas 4) for 55 to 60 minutes.
From Sister Doyle, who brings one in every Friday

Dietetics Department Recipe Card No. 12
Lentil and Carrot Soup, serves 4, approx. 210 kcal per serving
1 onion, chopped
3 carrots, diced
150g red lentils, rinsed
1.2 litres low-salt vegetable stock
1/2 tsp ground cumin
Soften the onion in 1 tbsp oil, add everything else and simmer for 25 minutes, then blend until smooth.
Salt per serving: 0.6g

Mike's Office Potluck Chili
Serves 8
2 lb ground beef
1 large onion, diced
2 cans (15 oz each) kidney beans, drained
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
2 tbsp chili powder
1 1/2 tsp ground cumin
Brown the beef and onion, add the rest and simmer for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.
Bring your own slow cooker. Label it with your name and floor number!

Night Shift Overnight Oats
40g rolled oats
120ml semi-skimmed milk
2 tbsp Greek yogurt
1 tsp honey
Handful of blueberries
Stir together in a jar, cover and chill for at least 4 hours. Eat cold at your 3am break.
About 310 kcal and 14g protein per jar.

Nurses' Station Snickerdoodles
Makes 24 cookies
1/2 cup butter, softened
1 cup sugar
1 large egg
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
1 tsp cream of tartar
1/2 tsp baking soda
2 tbsp sugar and 2 tsp cinnamon for rolling
Roll into 1 inch balls, coat in cinnamon sugar and bake at 375°F for 9 to 10 minutes.

Tortilla Española, from the Canteen at Torre Norte
Serves 6
500g potatoes, thinly sliced
1 onion, thinly sliced
6 large eggs
150ml olive oil
1/2 tsp salt
Cook the potatoes and onion slowly in the oil for 20 minutes until soft, drain, then mix with the beaten eggs and salt.
Cook in a 24cm pan over a low heat for 8 minutes, turn out onto a plate and slide back in for 4 more.

Build-Up Smoothie, Nutrition Support Team
For patients who need extra calories, approx. 450 kcal per glass
200ml full-fat milk
1 small banana
2 tbsp smooth peanut butter
1 tbsp skimmed milk powder
2 tsp honey
Blend for 30 seconds and serve straight away. Not suitable for anyone with a nut allergy.

Lemon Drizzle Squares, from the Staff Bake Sale
Makes 16
225g self-raising flour
225g softened butter
225g caster sugar
4 eggs
Zest of 2 lemons
Topping: juice of 1 1/2 lemons and 85g granulated sugar
